decision_enabled: Choose the smallest contextual-discovery implementation for one real external-user journey without opaque ranking, inferred sensitive traits, universal reputation or a premature matching engine.
core_question: How can a person discover relevant projects, opportunities, people or learning contexts from explicit metadata and user-controlled context, with understandable reasons for inclusion?

existing_cz_foundations.boundary: Do not infer Actor competency, proficiency or verification from opportunity requirements.
Do not convert intention text into inferred sensitive traits or an opaque user profile.

properties: BLOCKED raw content dominates ordinary access
existing_cz_foundations.boundary: Discovery must obey existing visibility/content-lifecycle rules and data-minimisation decisions.

use: GIN indexing when scale justifies it
precedents.boundary: PostgreSQL ranking is application-specific. If ts_rank/ts_rank_cd is later used, expose it as lexical search ordering only, never as recommendation, trust, competence or endorsement.

use: similarity for names/labels when exact/full-text search is insufficient
precedents.boundary: Similarity is lexical similarity, not semantic relevance, user affinity or trust.

use: database views/functions for more complex queries
precedents.boundary: Authorization remains database/RLS-driven; filters do not create permission.
HSDS is a human-services exchange model, not Célula Zero's internal ontology. Adopt discovery dimensions/patterns only where a real use case requires them.
Product interaction precedent only; do not adopt Decidim runtime solely for search.
JobPosting is narrower than CZ Opportunity. Map only for external serialization/interchange when an opportunity genuinely resembles a job/opening.

architecture_decisions.mechanism: pg_trgm only if lived search shows lexical recall failure
deterministic reason codes emitted by a narrow read-model/RPC
architecture_decisions.concrete_property_lost_without_custom_cr: A user can receive results without knowing whether each item matched text, an explicitly selected competency relation, visibility/state constraints, or another declared filter.

architecture_decisions.mechanism: small SQL view/RPC over existing Project + OpportunityVersion + competency relations
architecture_decisions.concrete_property_lost_without_custom_cr: Existing objects remain queryable separately, but one external-user discovery journey cannot obtain a stable, privacy-aware projection with explicit result type and reason codes.
Not demonstrated. WORLD-003 must first test whether accepted intent + opportunity + explicit filters already preserve the required discovery property.

architecture_decisions.mechanism: map later from HSDS/Schema.org patterns only if real journey requires it
architecture_decisions.concrete_property_lost_without_custom_cr: No current external-user discovery case has demonstrated location as a required constraint.
None demonstrated; lexical and explicit metadata search have not yet failed.
None demonstrated and it would create person-level profiling.

minimal_result_contract_candidate.boundary: Reason codes explain inclusion. They do not prove relevance, endorsement, competence, trust or suitability.

candidate: then lexical match if text query supplied
ordering_policy.lexical_rank_boundary: If PostgreSQL lexical rank is used later, label and expose it as lexical ordering only.

privacy_security_constraints: Apply object visibility/RLS before discovery output.
BLOCKED content must not be indexed or returned through a discovery projection.
Do not use raw intention text to infer protected/sensitive traits.
Do not persist search history by default.
Do not create Actor competency state merely to support discovery.
Public visibility does not authorize sensitive-trait inference.
